rows.en: (Sheryl's concert is finally here!)

\p-kun,
you seem awfully excited.

Well, yeah, Sheryl's having a concert!
Aren't you looking forward to it, Shirakawa?

W-well, I... haven't really listened to
much of Sheryl-san's music.

Yeah, I can kind of picture you being into
classical music and stuff, Shirakawa.

And you're still going to Sheryl's concert?
Isn't it hard, learning all the songs and stuff?
rows.notes: sanka suru read as attending the concert; 'learning the songs' = learning them to enjoy/sing along.

rows.en:
Yes...
But they're all such lovely songs,
so it's fun.

(Maybe it'd be fun for all of us
to go see it together...)
(Sheryl's concert is finally here!)

\p-san,
you seem awfully excited.

Well, yeah, Sheryl's having a concert!
Aren't you looking forward to it, Miyuki?

W-well, I... haven't really listened to
much music like Sheryl-san's.

Yeah, I can kind of picture you being into
classical music and stuff, Miyuki.

Then isn't going to Sheryl's concert hard?
Learning all the songs and stuff?

(Maybe it'd be fun for all of us
to go see it together...)

(They found a new planet...
It still doesn't feel real at all.)

\p-kun,
I hear they've found a new planet.
It's all anyone's talking about on the news.
Is it not something you're very interested in?

It just doesn't click for me, y'know?
Even if they say there's a new planet.
Yeah, same here.

I've lived here on Frontier my whole life,
so I'm attached to it, too...

They tell us out of nowhere they've found
a new planet, but still...
That's true...

It's not like we'll get there right away.
Let's take our time thinking it over.
(I wonder what kind of life is waiting for us...)

(They found a new planet...
It still doesn't feel real at all.)

\p-san,
I hear they've found a new planet.
It's all anyone's talking about on the news.

It just doesn't click for me.
Even if they say there's a new planet.

They tell us out of nowhere they've found
a new planet, but I mean, really...

(...I just can't seem to fall asleep...
Maybe I'll go for a little walk.)
Huh, is that Shirakawa over there?
I just couldn't sleep...
I couldn't sleep either, so I came out.
Though mine's just a walk.

Hehe.
Well then, I'm off for my run.
Be careful out there at night.
(Maybe I'll go for a little jog too.)
Huh, is that Miyuki over there...?
I couldn't sleep either, so I came out~
Though mine's just a walk.
(Maybe I'll go for a little jog too.)

Is that...
Shirakawa!

\p-kun...
What are you doing in a place like this...?

Just making the rounds a bit...
What about you, Shirakawa?

...Same here.
I wanted to check on the damage.
This is the city we have to protect, after all...
Yeah, you're right.
I'll head home first...

Is that...
Miyuki!

\p-san...
What are you doing in a place like this...?

Just making the rounds a bit...
What about you, Miyuki?
This is the city we have to protect, after all.
(Exams are finally over...)

Good work,
\p-kun.
rows.notes: otsukaresama after exams: 'Good work', layout as the earlier 'Hello,<NL>\p-kun.'

rows.en:
Oh, Shirakawa...
Now that exams are over, I feel totally drained.
Think you got good scores?
Hmm, I wonder...

Studying is all about steady, everyday effort.
Let's make sure we keep up with our
prep and review.
Y-yeah, you're right...
Well then, I'll be going.
(...Was that Shirakawa's way of encouraging me?)

Good work,
\p-san.

Miyuki~
Now that exams are over, I feel totally drained.
Hmm, who knows?
(...Was that Miyuki's way of encouraging me?)

uncertain: c18329/c18337: sanka suru taken as attending Sheryl's concert; the 'learning the songs' worry reads as preparing to enjoy it.
c18379/c18387: otsukaresama after exams given as 'Good work, \p-kun/-san.'
